## Install the skills

Ask your agent:

> Run `dascore skills --install <directory>`, giving your personal skills directory, to install every DASCore skill.

The command copies each skill into that directory and replaces older copies, so run it again after upgrading DASCore. Reload the agent if needed, then ask it to use DASCore on your data. If `dascore` is not on your path, run `python -m dascore` with the project's Python; see [Local documentation](local_documentation.qmd).

## Included skills

`dascore` is the entry point: it finds the APIs and workflows of the DASCore installed in your project.

| Skill | Documentation | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dascore` | [Choose a DASCore workflow](../recipes/dascore.qmd) | Find APIs, inspect data, and choose a procedure. |
| `make-inventory` | [Create an inventory](../recipes/tunnel_inventory.qmd) | Create, validate, repair, and attach observing-system metadata. |
| `make-annotations` | [Annotations](annotations.qmd) | Turn a table of picks, ranges, or shapes into an annotation set. |
| `make-namespace` | [Extending DASCore](../contributing/extending_dascore.qmd) | Add methods to DASCore objects from a namespace or plugin package. |
| `migrate-to-v1` | [Migrate to DASCore 1.0](../migrations/dascore_1.0_migration.qmd) | Update projects using the 0.1.x APIs. |
| `test-beta` | [Test the latest pre-release](../migrations/test_latest_beta.qmd) | Try a pre-release in isolation and draft problem reports. |

Run `dascore skills` to list available workflows, or `dascore skill <name>` to read one. Each linked page is the same procedure served by the CLI. The migration and beta-testing pages can also be given directly to an agent without installing the skill.

## Development skills

These are for work on DASCore itself. Their descriptions begin with "DASCore development".

| Skill | Documentation | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `add-format` | [Adding a New Format](../contributing/new_format.qmd) | Read or write a new file format. |
| `start-task` | [Start a task](../contributing/start_task.qmd) | Set up a worktree and environment for a change. |
| `draft-release` | [Draft a release](../contributing/draft_release.qmd) | Propose the next version and its release notes. |

## Where skills live

Every skill is a `SKILL.md` file under `dascore/.agents/skills/` in the installed package, where tools that link skills from a project's dependencies find them.
